capabilities: Track tasks by typing TODO/DOING/DONE keyword lines in any note
Collect a vault-wide Task List with search, filters, urgency sort, and priorities
Convert natural-language dates to structured Org dates
Aggregate task counts with todoseq-dashboard cards in notes
Auto-archive aged DONE tasks to ARCHIVED with preview and undo
extras: Full documentation lives at scross01.github.io/obsidian-todoseq rather than in the README; released under MIT.
motivation: The author says most task managers force you into a separate system, and built TODOseq to work inside existing notes with no checkboxes.
problem: Obsidian's task support centers on checkbox syntax, and separate task managers pull work out of notes; there is no built-in vault-wide list built from plain keyword lines.

relations.evidence: Keep writing in ordinary notes — inspired by Emacs Org-mode and Logseq.
Logseq / Org-mode compatible, including natural-language dates

summary: Keyword-based task tracker that collects TODO/DOING/DONE lines across the vault into one filterable Task List, Logseq/Org-mode style.
